reader.requirement: A data description entry written with no data-name and no FILLER is a FILLER item in every respect, elementary or group, with REDEFINES, OCCURS or as a conditional variable, in the File, Working-Storage, Communication and Linkage Sections (INITIALIZE ignores it as an elementary FILLER, CORRESPONDING does not pair it, it cannot be referenced), while a 77 entry still needs a data-name; the witness covers unnamed elementary items in Working-Storage only.

edition-consulted.switches: whether a word at the head of an entry is the entry's name or the first clause of an unnamed entry, by the word's reserved status at the edition

reader.edition-search: BindEntry's isFiller (name null or FILLER) reads no edition; LevelNumberPass reads none.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 `05 NATIONAL PIC X(3)` and `05 BIT PIC X` name items NATIONAL and BIT (the words are not reserved); at 2023 the same entries are unnamed USAGE NATIONAL / BIT items and references to them are refused (COBOL0901)

reader.notes: The binder folds the omitted name and FILLER into one isFiller fact. Every later rule that excludes FILLER therefore sees an unnamed entry the same way. The edition shows up only in whether the head word of an entry is a name at all.

refuter.evidence: u_QUEUE, u_SEGMENT, u_EGI and u_TERMINAL (class c reverse: words 85 reserves for the Communication and Segmentation modules) each draw COBOL0901 at 85, so a word reserved only in 85 does not begin an unnamed entry. u2 (u2-001): an unnamed 01 REDEFINES in Working-Storage and an unnamed 01 under CD FOR INPUT print AR=AB QN=QQQQQQQQQQQQ. u3: an unnamed 66 RENAMES draws COBOL1747. u4: unnamed records under FD IS GLOBAL and unnamed 01 EXTERNAL or GLOBAL Working-Storage entries each draw COBOL2404, as §1985:X.4.3.3 SR5 requires for an omitted name treated as FILLER. In the reader's p55a, the unnamed group and the FILLER group get the same CORRESPONDING treatment (§1985:VI.6.4.3 GR1: neither is a qualifier). cite.py: OK §1985:VI.5.5.4 GR1; OK §1985:X.4.3.3 SR5; OK §1985:VI.6.4.3 (it lies in GR1).
